name: nfsen-ng-docker
what_it_is: A Docker Compose setup that runs nfsen-ng (a PHP/Apache NetFlow visualizer with RRD-backed graphs) alongside nfdump (a NetFlow/sFlow collector) with support for multiple concurrent flow sources. Each source is defined in a CSV config file and gets a dedicated capture daemon bound to a UDP port in the 9000–9099 range.
components: nfsen-ng (PHP 7.4/Apache web UI — mbolli/nfsen-ng cloned at build time)
nfsen entrypoint.sh (sources.conf parser that seeds nfsen-ng config at startup)
nfdump entrypoint.sh (launches sfcapd/nfcapd per source, watchdog loop every 60 s)
measurement: Per-source RRD graphs (flows, packets, bytes) with configurable display: sources | protocols | ports
Flow table queries via nfdump binary (max 1 concurrent process by default)
configuration: sources.conf — CSV file: 'device;port;proto' (proto: nflow | sflow), ports must be unique in 9000–9099
settings.php — nfsen-ng config: sources list, RRD DB, nfdump binary path, frontend defaults
docker-compose.yaml — exposes port 81→80 (web UI) and UDP 9000–9099 (collectors); shared profiles-data volume
Live reload: edit sources.conf then run 'docker-compose restart' — no rebuild required
fault_injection: Watchdog loop in nfdump entrypoint detects missing sfcapd/nfcapd processes every 60 s and exits (triggering Docker restart policy)
restart: unless-stopped on both services ensures automatic recovery after process failure
modes: graphs view (default) — RRD time-series per source, protocol, or port
flows view — paginated flow record table via nfdump query
statistics view — aggregated stats ordered by bytes/packets/flows
constraints: Source ports must be unique and within the UDP range 9000–9099; values outside this range are not mapped by docker-compose
Maximum 1 concurrent nfdump query process (max-processes: 1 in settings.php) — parallel flow queries are serialized
nfsen-ng source list is rewritten from sources.conf only at container startup; adding/removing sources requires a full stack restart
No authentication or TLS on the web UI — HTTP only on port 81
nfsen-ng is cloned from GitHub at image build time (no pinned version/commit), so builds are not reproducible without caching
docker_services: nfsen — PHP 7.4/Apache web UI, port 81:80/tcp, volume: ./profiles-data:/var/nfdump/profiles-data
nfdump — Debian 10 collector daemon(s), ports 9000-9099:9000-9099/udp, volume: ./profiles-data:/data
notable_absences: No authentication or access control on the web interface
No pinned upstream nfsen-ng version (git clone HEAD at build time)
No support for NetFlow sources outside the 9000–9099 port range without editing docker-compose.yaml
